data.spiritual_significance: It is a name deeply rooted in faith and spirituality, symbolizing a strong connection with the divine realm and the constant presence of God. The name carries the power of the Seraphim, who are believed to encircle the throne of God and continually cry out, "Holy, Holy, Holy is the Lord of hosts." Bearers of this name are encouraged to keep their hearts and minds focused on the divine presence and to live their lives in accordance with God's will.

He was known for his extraordinary ascetic feats and miraculous powers, and was revered by the local population.

Saint Seraphinus of Valtice, also known as Seraphim of Valtice, was a Bohemian priest who lived during the late 13th and early 14th centuries. He was renowned for his piety and was known to have performed many miracles. He was canonized by the Roman Catholic Church in 1623.
